source_access: Primary publisher indexed full text Sections2.1–2.3/3.3 and pinned author PX40 code reviewed. No original paper figure pixels or digitization claimed.
source_selector: After five-point triangle filtering of midpoint depth-integrated northward velocity, find minimum west of150E, then maximum strictly west of that minimum. Positive poleward component is northward. This distinguishes source-selected Kuroshio from farther offshore KE meanders.
identity_scope: Source Kuroshio segment downstream of Izu Ridge, as distinguished in source Section3.3 from offshore KE meanders. Not a full-route estimate, inheritance into KE or a claim that all PX40 flow belongs to Kuroshio.
support_findings: All192 axes fall in the declared138–145E gate, actual140.65–144.85E. Each calendar mean retains16 year-specific axis profiles at every retained depth.
Every mean has its sampled maximum at shallowest2.5m native level. The surface/unsampled shallower maximum is unresolved.

All12 means resolve5cm/s and10cm/s crossings between finite adjacent native levels. All12 zero crossing diagnoses are right-censored at1975m. A current bottom or vertical thickness is not established.

Velocities are cross-transect components, not full horizontal speed magnitudes. Argo reference-velocity error and hydrographic reconstruction uncertainty are not propagated into fabricated depth confidence limits.
